g.title: Steinway B · 6′11″ long × ~4′10″ wide · keys/bench N (windows) · tail S · lid/treble opens W toward fireplace · FITS in the 17 ft N–S living room: 2 ft walk along the north windows + 3 ft bench clearance behind the keys + 6′11″ body leaves ~5 ft south of the tail. ~2.5 ft path between the case and the stair; a wide path west to the fireplace. The 3 ft bench zone is north of the keys (z≈2–5). Dedicated window walk plus bench both fit; mover path through the hall/dining is unverified. Player faces south; treble/right is west, so the lid projects toward the room center and fireplace.
